definitions.explanation: A formal written document submitted to resign from a position, typically used in the context of employment or public office.

examples.japanese: {辞表|じひょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{出|だ}す→出す：01087_dasu⟧。
⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{上司|じょうし}→上司：03286_joushi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{辞表|じひょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{提出|ていしゅつ}した→提出する：19644_teishutsusuru⟧。
examples.english: He submitted his resignation letter to his boss.

examples.japanese: ⟦{大臣|だいじん}→大臣：03417_daijin⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{責任|せきにん}→責任：03298_sekinin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取|と}って→取る：00565_toru⟧{辞表|じひょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{提出|ていしゅつ}した→提出する：19644_teishutsusuru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{報道|ほうどう}→報道：04438_houdou⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: It was reported that the minister submitted his resignation letter to take responsibility.

notes:
A formal term for a written resignation, most commonly associated with white-collar jobs and government positions. In Japanese workplace culture, submitting a {辞表|じひょう} is a significant and formal act, often preceded by verbal discussions with supervisors.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {辞表|じひょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{出|だ}す→出す：01087_dasu⟧: to submit a resignation letter (casual)
- {辞表|じひょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{提出|ていしゅつ}する→提出する：19644_teishutsusuru⟧: to submit a resignation letter (formal)
- {辞表|じひょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受理|じゅり}→受理：12032_juri⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to accept a resignation letter
- {辞表|じひょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{撤回|てっかい}→撤回：12910_tekkai⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to withdraw a resignation letter
- {辞表|じひょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{書|か}く→書く：00477_kaku⟧: to write a resignation letter

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{退職届|たいしょくとどけ}→退職届：15695_taishokutodoke⟧: a notification of resignation — the employee has already decided and is informing the company. More final than {辞表|じひょう}.
- ⟦{退職願|たいしょくねがい}→退職願：28562_taishokunegai⟧: a request to resign — the employee is asking for permission to leave. Slightly softer than {辞表|じひょう}.
- {辞表|じひょう} is used mainly for managers, executives, and public officials. Ordinary employees typically use ⟦{退職届|たいしょくとどけ}→退職届：15695_taishokutodoke⟧ or ⟦{退職願|たいしょくねがい}→退職願：28562_taishokunegai⟧.
